notes.title: 🚜 Rotten Forgotten Demo is Here! Gather Your Friends & Start Farming! 🌱
notes.content:
The wait is over—the Rotten Forgotten demo is live on Steam! 🎉 Grab your friends (or go solo) and jump into this quirky co-op farming adventure where teamwork, strategy, and a little chaos will decide the fate of your run-down homestead.

🐄 Care for your animals
🌽 Grow and harvest crops
🛡️ Defend your farm from pesky wildlife
⏳ Race against time to save your family barn!

Play now and let us know what you think! Your feedback will help shape the future of Rotten Forgotten. Download the demo, team up, and start farming today! 🚜💨
